brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility chain requirements with no serious or minor errors. The doctor correctly established right-eye laterality, screened for red flags, clarified the discharge medication plan, distinguished preoperative from discharge medications, created a practical caregiver execution plan with a logging method, addressed follow-up with concrete next steps, and handled diabetes/hypertension appropriately. HO1 is complete—the doctor elicited caregiver rotation barriers and co-designed a refrigerator checklist system with right-eye labeling. HO3 is complete with explicit bounded closure reasoning distinguishing resolved items from verification tasks. HO4 is complete with calibrated reassurance that verified improvement against targeted screening. Only one high-order point is meaningfully completed, capping the grade at Strong.

This was sufficient for safety but not beyond-minimum discovery.
